sn45.12:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa temāsassa accayena paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn45.12:2.2: Yena svāham bhikkhave vihārena pathamābhisambuddho viharāmi tassa padesena vihāsiṃ || || 4.
